text:
oliver: Quick heads up — CI's been flaky on main this morning and we have a deploy freeze starting at 11:45 UTC for the scheduled rollout. Please HOLD merges that touch runtime, infra, or shared config until we confirm smoke tests are stable.

sasha: Copy. My PR touches runtime (PR #6122). Can I get a short rebase slot?

oliver: Yes — we have a 15m rebase window 11:30–11:45 UTC. Rebase only during that window, do not merge. Tag me when you start.

jen: Agree with hold. Also gate merges on the `smoke` job passing. If smoke fails, we hold all merges until root-cause fixed.

ci-bot: ci-bot: smoke-tests failed on commit abc123 — failing test: `kv_cache_integration`. Logs: https://ci.internal/abc123/log

devon: I can help triage the smoke failure. @sasha if you rebase during the window ping me for a quick review.

sasha: Thanks — starting rebase now: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main` — will ping when done.

jen: Plan: if smoke green after rebase, we'll allow merges that are non-breaking between 12:00–12:15 UTC as small fast-follows. Otherwise freeze remains until all smoke/regressions cleared.

oliver: Note for everyone: for emergency merges (hotfix to prod) escalate oncall and include a rollback plan and tokenized QA steps. Otherwise hold. :thumbsup:

devon: pinged the infra team about `kv_cache_integration` flake, they acked. Will post update in ~10m.

ci-bot: ci-bot: smoke-tests passed on commit def456 (retrigger after rebase). Status: ✅

sasha: Rebase + smoke pass. Ready for review and merge during allowed window. Thanks all.

jen: I'll take the review now, aiming to merge at 12:05 UTC if no regressions.

oliver: Great — locking this thread for visibility. Remember: no merges touching infra outside allowed window. Thanks!
